source: USDA ERS Commodity Costs and Returns
units: USD per planted acre (nominal), except yield (per planted acre, bu or lb) and harvest price
practice: ALL (ERS does not publish irrigated vs dryland cost splits; irrigated_pct_of_acres gives the irrigated share of the region's survey base)
notes: allocated overhead includes opportunity cost of land and unpaid labor and capital recovery; for a cash-cost view use operating_usd_ac.
Prairie Gateway = ERS Farm Resource Region covering western Kansas, Oklahoma, Texas panhandle, eastern Colorado/New Mexico, southern Nebraska.
No irrigated-specific cost source was reachable (KSU AgManager farm management guides at www.agmanager.info: proxy CONNECT 403). Pumping energy cost per acre-foot is not derived.
Latest year (2025) values are ERS estimates based on the survey base year listed per crop.
